messages:
Maya (People Ops): Thanks for the great Qs today. Thread to capture follow-ups about the Q3 hiring plan, banding, and what managers should do this week. Drop anything I missed.

Diego (Eng - Oncall): Quick one: the reorg note said two runtime slots get pooled. If I interview someone & theyre a fit, do I send the offer or wait for central placement?

Sahil (VP Eng): Diego 1: Interview as normal. If the req is `POOL_RUNTIME`, teams make a recommendation; central ops will confirm placement within 7 business days. If you need an offer earlier, flag it as "expedite" and @Maya will route.

Jonas (CTO): Also: we're emphasizing senior hires for infra. If you plan to up-level a req from L3->L4, include a 1-2 bullet justification (impact timeline + why external vs internal). We'll review within 5 business days.

Priya (Finance): Budget addendum: total headcount envelope unchanged. We can prioritize senior hires but need to keep average comp assumptions aligned. If asked for relocation or sign-on exceptions, route to Finance with a short ROI note.

Elliot (Recruiter): Sourcing note: agencies should prioritize folks senior enough to lead infra projects (L4+). I'll post the revised external blurb today: "Targeted Q3 hiring: infra, platform, devex."

Maya (People Ops): Onboarding snippet (will publish full doc in handbook):
```
Onboard 8-week plan (L4-L5):
Week 0: hardware + access, buddy assigned
Week 1: team syncs + small diagnostic task
Weeks 2-3: pair on infra flows, runbook review
Weeks 4-6: own a hotfix/automation project
Weeks 7-8: handover + 90-day success goals
```
I'll link the full checklist once live.

Diego (Eng - Oncall): Helpful. One more: interviewing cadence — are managers expected to join every loop?

Sahil (VP Eng): Managers should attend at least one of the first 3 interviews for a hire on their team. Also, we added a "scale case" prompt to take-homes for infra hires to check systems thinking.

Maya (People Ops): Internal moves recap: transfers <2 bands = internal transfer form (no new req). Moves >=2 bands require a new req + People Ops sign-off. Please include a 2-bullet growth plan.

Jonas (CTO): Messaging for external partners: avoid the words "reorg" or "hiring spree". Use "targeted Q3 hiring to strengthen infra & platform".

Priya (Finance): If a manager wants to convert a pooled slot to permanent on their team, submit a 2-line case and tag @Jonas + @Priya. We aim to answer within 5 business days.

Maya (People Ops): I'll make a one-pager tonight: approval SLAs, pool tags, onboarding link, scorecard note. Will post to the handbook and ping this thread when live. DM me for urgent approvals.

hr-bot: New doc posted -> https://handbook.redwood.ai/hiring/q3-orientation (doc id: 904)

Diego (Eng - Oncall): Thanks Maya. This is super clear :thumbsup:

Elliot (Recruiter): Adding calibration session for managers Fri 10am PT 1 invite to follow.

Maya (People Ops): Closing the loop here 1 will update the handbook and share the link.
